title: Context Engineering at Scale
description: Master advanced techniques for managing massive codebases within LLM context windows to maintain precision and avoid hallucinations.
learning_objectives: Analyze the 'Lost in the Middle' phenomenon and its impact on large-context retrieval
Implement strategic pruning using AI-specific ignore files to reduce token noise
Construct hierarchical codebase maps for high-density context injection
Execute a multi-step workflow to resolve bugs in million-token projects without overloading the model

sections.heading: The Paradox of Large Context Windows
sections.content_brief: Explain that while 1M+ token windows exist, model recall degrades in the middle of the prompt (Lost in the Middle). Discuss why 'dumping everything' leads to hallucinations and decreased reasoning quality.

sections.heading: Strategic Pruning and Noise Reduction
sections.content_brief: Detail how to use `.cursorignore`, `.windsurfignore`, or custom scripts to exclude lockfiles, build artifacts, and redundant documentation. Show how removing noise increases the 'signal-to-noise' ratio for the LLM.
sections.code_context: A comprehensive .cursorignore file optimized for a large TypeScript/React project to minimize token waste.

sections.heading: Hierarchical Summarization: The Codebase Map
sections.content_brief: Introduce the concept of creating a 'Map' (e.g., CODEBASE_MAP.md) that describes the architecture, module responsibilities, and key API surfaces. Explain how providing this map allows the LLM to request specific files rather than guessing.
sections.code_context: An example of a high-density project map showing directory structures paired with 1-sentence functional descriptions.

sections.heading: Context Compression: Skeletal Code Injection
sections.content_brief: Teach the technique of providing 'skeletons' (function signatures and types without implementation bodies) for large files. Explain when to use full source code versus skeletal versions to save tokens.
sections.code_context: Comparison between a 500-line implementation file and its compressed 'signature-only' version.

sections.heading: End-to-End Example: Debugging a Million-Token Project
sections.content_brief: A concrete step-by-step walkthrough showing the full sequence from user input through each intermediate step (pruning, map reference, targeted file inclusion) to final output for a complex cross-module bug.
sections.code_context: A sequence of prompts demonstrating the 'Zoom-In' method: Global Map -> Module Summary -> Specific File -> Implementation.

admonitions.content: Avoid the 'Token Trap': Just because a model supports 2 million tokens doesn't mean it can reason across all of them with equal precision. Always prefer curated context over raw dumps.
Keep your CODEBASE_MAP.md updated as part of your PR process. A stale map is worse than no map, as it will lead the AI to reference non-existent files.
